items.document_title: ICS Integrated Cryocooling System data sheet V2.3 (Seiko EG&G, ORTEC)
items.location: ICS data sheet Rev 2.3 (Seiko EG&G, July 2019, ORTEC-manufactured), page 2, typical cool-down time row, ICS-P4 column
items.note: Typical cool-down time (冷却時間（代表値）) for the ICS-P4 by detector relative efficiency: <40% 6-8 h, 40-70% 12-14 h, 80-100% 14-18 h. The column was attributed to ICS-P4 from PDF word positions (x~350, under the ICS-P4 header; the ICS/ICS-E column reads 5/6/7 h). The configuration does not fix the GEM capsule efficiency, so 18 h (upper end of the highest documented band) is used as max; capsules above 100% relative efficiency are not covered. Values are typical, from the Japanese distributor data sheet; ORTEC's English ICS brochure gives no cool-down time.
